request: Run one materially corrected Core generic actual READY-model dual-client concurrent inference to verify fairness and durable p50/p95/TTFT metrics. The earlier exact test completed with cold-start deadline and insufficient response token budget; clean only old owned temp after completion. Shared idle guard; no model state modifications outside Coordinator.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
old=/tmp/ai_core_shared_acceptance_ce5cf8c
new=/tmp/ai_core_shared_acceptance_9c4c36ad
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = ce5cf8c152219af0beda7161b5621fc5883bbf8d
test -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
git -C "$w" fetch --no-tags origin feat/per-model-lifecycle-20261013 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 9c4c36adbb9636a5cf45f72497d6d837f9effb0e
git -C "$w" checkout --detach -q 9c4c36adbb9636a5cf45f72497d6d837f9effb0e
docker exec ai-core-model-gate test -f "$old.exit"
docker exec ai-core-model-gate rm -f "$old.py" "$old.json" "$old.exit"
docker exec ai-core-model-gate sh -c 'test ! -e "$1" && test ! -e "$2" && test ! -e "$3"' _ "$new.py" "$new.json" "$new.exit"
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os,json,urllib.request;h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]};f=lambda p:json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184"+p,headers=h),timeout=8));a=f("/internal/handoff/status");r=f("/internal/resources/status");assert not a["handoff"] and not a["recovery_pending"] and not any(a["active"].values()) and r["queued"]==0'
docker exec -i ai-core-model-gate sh -c 'umask 077; cat > "$1"' _ "$new.py" < "$w/scripts/host_shared_admission_metrics_acceptance.py"
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -m py_compile "$new.py"
docker exec -d ai-core-model-gate sh -c 'python3 "$1" > "$2" 2>&1; printf "%s" "$?" > "$3"' _ "$new.py" "$new.json" "$new.exit"
echo AI_CORE_READY_MODEL_CONCURRENCY_RUN=STARTED
